environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with a NAT gateway attached to the route table (rtb-0a3f7c). The task role has sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage on the notification queue. The subnet's route table has 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0x8f2a1b. No network ACL restrictions on outbound traffic. Security group sg-04a8b allows all outbound (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports). SQS queue policy allows SendMessage from the application's API tier role.
